classes.name: Warrior
classes.desc: Physically stronger than everyone else, Warriors are great in melee combat. They can use either two-handed weapons or a one-handed weapon with a shield. After the first promotion, Warriors go on to specialize as Myrmidons, using two-hand weapons and skills like Howl and Warcry to deal big-time damage; or Sentries, using one-hand weapons, shields, and skills like Defend and Taunt to up their defensive ability.

classes.name: Commando
classes.desc: A Myrmidon is a warrior who specializes in assault, using two-handed weapons and offensive skills to deal big-time damage in melee combat. Myrmidons form the main attacking force for the Bellato Federation.

classes.name: Miler
classes.desc: Using weapon and shield instead of two-hand weapons, the Sentry balances attack and defense ability. With skills specializing in strategic shield techniques, Sentries play an important defensive role in the Bellato Federation.

classes.name: Berserker
classes.desc: A highly specialized offensive warrior, the Berserker can attack fast and slow opponents down to deal big-time damage in melee combat. Berserkers are named after the fearsome legendary fighters from ancient history.

classes.name: Armsman
classes.desc: Wardens specialize in the use of the mace, and learn both offensive and defensive mace techniques that break opponents balance.

classes.name: Shield Miler
classes.desc: A Sentinel is a shield specialist with the ability to absorb opponents HP. Sentinels can be found at the frontline of every battle.

classes.name: Vindicator
classes.desc: Vindicators are the Bellato Union's tribunal knights: holy warriors who pass sentence with a blade of light. They rally allies under a verdict, smite the guilty, cleanse and mend the wounded and stand behind a sworn bulwark. Third promotion for Berserker, Armsman and Shield Miler units.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.desc: Rangers specialize in ranged combat, using bows or guns to get opponents from afar. Theyre fast enough to avoid a lot of damage. After the first promotion, Rangers go on to become Sharpshooters, which focus on doing combat damage; or Vigilantes, which learn skills like Hide and Trapping to gain the advantage over enemies.

classes.name: Desperado
classes.desc: Though not as awesome as the Sharpshooter in ranged combat, the Vigilante can hold its own in both ranged and melee situations. Most of their skills focus on one-on-one melee combat using light weapons.

classes.name: Sniper
classes.desc: Sharpshooters are ranged specialists, with skills that improve accuracy and damage over long distances. They like to avoid melee combat whenever possible.

classes.name: Hidden Soldier
classes.desc: Snipers are better than anyone when it comes to firearm skills. Theyre usually placed at the rear of the battle, to take opponents down from afar.

classes.name: Sentinel
classes.desc: Harriers use both ranged skills and Force to deal with opponents. They can also keep enemies from using Force against them.

classes.name: Infiltrator
classes.desc: A secret force! Sabeteurs penetrate enemy lines and demoralize opponents.

classes.name: Pathfinder
classes.desc: Pathfinders are the Bellato Union's forward scouts: marksmen who read the field before the army arrives. They call targets for their allies, sprint along hidden trails, pierce distant marks with a single long-range shot, tend the wounded in the field and rain a skewering volley on whole packs. Third promotion for Sniper, Harrier and Infiltrator units.

classes.name: Heavy Gunner
classes.desc: Heavy Gunners are Bellato shock troops built around the heavy shotgun. They plant themselves in a punishing stance, clear whole arcs with buckshot, mark prey for the squad, finish a target at point-blank and brace behind hexagonal plating. Third promotion for Sniper, Harrier and Infiltrator units.

classes.name: Sapper
classes.desc: Sappers are the Bellato Union's field demolition experts: trappers who turn any patch of ground into a hazard. They snare targets in weighted nets, blind a crowd with a magnesium flare, slip away as a ghost, sense every hidden trap and cut a wide killing zone into the earth. Third promotion for Sniper, Harrier and Infiltrator units.

classes.name: Spiritualist
classes.desc: Bellato Mystics can use any kind of Force except for those used by the Corites. After the first promotion, Mystics go on to become Mages, whch specialize in attack Forces; or Chandras, which specialize in healing and support Forces.

classes.name: Psyper
classes.desc: Mages use Force and special skills to damage their opponents. They usually have just a few, if any, support Forces in their bag of tricks.

classes.name: Candra
classes.desc: Chandras like to use Force constructively rather than destructively. They concentrate on suppressing Dark Force and using Light Forces to help others.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.desc: Possibly the most aggressive Force users, ArchMages use both staves and attack Forces to overcome even the strongest defenses.

classes.name: Astral
classes.desc: Chronomancers serve as supportive Force users, using assisting Forces and skills, including a special ability to transfer allies to safety in sticky situations.

classes.name: Holy Candra
classes.desc: SoulChandras specialize in Light Force, using it to blind opponents and heal allies. They're extremely useful in combat situations.

classes.name: Radiant Archon
classes.desc: Radiant Archons are the Bellato Union's sun-priests: mages of pure holy light. They crown the squad with a halo of blades, raise a solar disc against the blow, mend the wounded with the dawn, hurl the Holy Lance and detonate a small sun in a golden corona. Third promotion for Astral and Holy Candra units.

classes.name: Chronarch
classes.desc: Chronarchs are the Bellato Union's masters of time and space. They cast faster than the eye can follow, collapse a sphere of compressed time upon the enemy, shatter its timeline so it acts slower, leave a sepia echo of themselves to fight beside them and freeze a foe in an hourglass of golden sand. Third promotion for Wizard and Astral units.

classes.name: Specialist
classes.desc: Specialists are more into production than combat. While they do hunt monsters like everyone else, its mostly to get the raw materials to make or upgrade items. After the first promotion, Specialists go on to become Mechanics, which handle high-grade production; or Riders, which operate the Massive Armor Units that are the pride of the Bellato army.

classes.name: Craftsman
classes.desc: Mechanics concentrate on mining, processing, producing, and upgrading items. They may not be combat soldiers, but their contribution makes combat possible for the Bellato Federation.

classes.name: Driver
classes.desc: Only Riders and Armor Drivers have the training and skills to operate Massive Armor Units (MAUs), the Bellatos best weapon in war. Riders can also use ranged weapons when not in harness.

classes.name: Mental Smith
classes.desc: Aside from managing the Bellato armor supply, Machinists also have medical tools and skills to heal their allies. They are production specialists and can help upgrade defense ability.

classes.name: Armor Rider
classes.desc: Armor Drivers handle premium MAUs, which are much more powerful than standard MAUs. Only the best Riders graduate to Amor Driver status.

classes.name: Field Engineer
classes.desc: Field Engineers are the Bellato Union's battlefield technicians: engineers who keep a squad standing under fire. They wrap allies in a reinforced frame, mend wounds with a wave of nanites, recharge the gauge, lay speed grids underfoot and snare enemies in a Tesla arc. Third promotion for Mental Smith units.

classes.name: Vanguard Pilot
classes.desc: Vanguard Pilots are the Bellato Union's elite M.A.U. commanders: pilots who prime their armor before the drop. On foot they overclock the reactor, plate the hull, weld the frame, fire the ejector boosters and lock a target for the guns. Effects keep running once you mount. Third promotion for Armor Rider units.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.desc: Physically stonger than other classes, Warriors excel in melee combat. They may wield either two-handed weapons or a one-handed weapon with a shield. After the first promotion, Warriors may opt to specialize as Crusaders, employing two-hand weapons and skills such as Vision and Faith to deal major damage; or Knights, using one-hand weapons, shields, and skills such as Trust and Life Leach to amplify their defensive ability.

classes.name: Champion
classes.desc: Crusaders actively pursue DECEMs glorification by focusing on two-handed melee attack skills that deal major damage to opponents.

classes.name: Knights
classes.desc: Knights glorify DECEM by balancing good attack capability with exceptional defensive skills.

classes.name: Templar
classes.desc: Blessed by DECEM with extraordinary physical might, Zealots focus on dealing damage and are implacable holy warriors in melee combat.

classes.name: Guardian
classes.desc: Commonly employed as protectors of DECEMs sanctuary, Paladins are swift fighters and are able to weaken opponents.

classes.name: Black Knights
classes.desc: Wielders of both Dark Force and physical might, Templars possess the capability to increase their defence and employ illusions that render opponents inutile.

classes.name: Dread Knight
classes.desc: Dread Knights are the Holy Chaos Coalition's black-armored executioners. They carve arcs of shadow through whole ranks, bind a foe in spectral chains, feed on their own bloodshed and stand behind a sarcophagus of bone and iron. Third promotion for Templar, Guardian and Black Knight units.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.desc: Rangers are extraordinary ranged combatants, wielding bows and guns to target foes from afar. They are exceptionally swift, allowing them to avoid considerable damage. After the first promotion, Rangers may opt to become either Archers, which deal greater damage over long distances; or Hunters, which employ skills such as Extinction and Trapping to hinder foes.

classes.name: Archer
classes.desc: Archers are experts in ranged combat, preferring to employ bows in lieu of firearms. Thus the majority of their class skills emphasize bow techniques.

classes.name: Hunter
classes.desc: Hunters are capable in both ranged and melee combat scenarios. Often employed as advance scouts, they possess the requisite skills.

classes.name: Adventurer
classes.desc: Marksmen possess extraordinary senses and the skills to use them, which translate into exceptional accuracy over enormous distances.

classes.name: Steeler
classes.desc: Though often self-serving, Sleepers tend to be independent and agile. This has its own usefulness, thus Sleepers are officially sanctioned by the Papal Authority.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.desc: A highly classified group, Redeemers serve as the stealth force of the Cora Alliance. Their existence is not generally known.

classes.name: Dusk Sniper
classes.desc: Dusk Snipers are the Holy Chaos Coalition's twilight marksmen. They lock onto a target with a steady aim, brand it with a crescent-moon mark, strike from beyond the horizon, end a fight with a single headshot and vanish in a flock of crows. Third promotion for Adventurer, Steeler and Assassin units.

classes.name: Windrider
classes.desc: Windriders are the Holy Chaos Coalition's storm archers, riding the wind itself. They settle into a wind stance, drill a single arrow through armor, dash in a burst of leaves, borrow a hawk's eye and call down a tornado of arrows on a whole pack. Third promotion for Adventurer, Steeler and Assassin units.

classes.name: Snaremaster
classes.desc: Snaremasters are the Holy Chaos Coalition's spirit hunters: trappers who weave snares out of soul-thread and poison. They bind a foe in a spectral lasso, wither a crowd in toxic cloud, vanish in black ink, read the omens of the battlefield and blanket the ground in a field of bursting spores. Third promotion for Adventurer, Steeler and Assassin units.

classes.name: Spiritualist
classes.desc: Spiritualists employ all Forces, save those used by the Bellato, to overcome their opponents. Following the first promotion, Spiritualists may opt to become either a Magus, which use Force directly to combat foes or Graziers, which are the only Force users that can summon Anima.

classes.name: Caster
classes.desc: Considered to be the founders of Force use, Magus' have become considerably more aggresive since the War of the Color, and tend to channel their Dark Force expertise expressly for combat purposes.

classes.name: Summoner
classes.desc: Summoners wield Force to draw and control spiritual energy, particularly the powerful otherworldly beings known as Anima. They may wield a few direct Forces, but every Grazier prefers to employ at least one Animus.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.desc: Widely recognized as the most efficient Force users, ArchMagus' possess the capability to render foes immobile and wield Force in combat to devastating effect.

classes.name: Dark Priest
classes.desc: Blessed by DECEM with the capability to instantly transport comrades to safety, Reaves serve as support Force wielders for the Holy Cora Alliance.

classes.name: Grazier
classes.desc: Fausts have the training, comprehension, and will to call and control the most powerful Anima.

classes.name: Elemental Master
classes.desc: Elemental Masters are the Holy Chaos Coalition's sovereigns of the four elements. Their Elemental Sovereignty raises ALL Force damage by 30%. Each master calls a twin of living ember, glacier, stone or storm, shatters the elemental resistance of a foe, wraps himself in a mantle of four ribbons and converges every element into one devastating blast. Third promotion for Warlock, Reave and Faust units.

classes.name: Umbral Priest
classes.desc: Umbral Priests are the dark clergy of the Holy Chaos Coalition: masters of curses and heirs of the summoners. They wither the enemy's strength, blast it with a plague of ashes, drink the life of the dying, fuse their animus with a legion of fire and shadow, raise three wraiths from the void and hurl the Netherbolt. Third promotion for Reave and Faust units.

classes.name: Nightwarden
classes.desc: Nightwardens are the Holy Chaos Coalition's shadow wardens: support mages who guard the squad from the dark. They mend allies with a rose-violet mist, cloak them in a second skin of shadow, erase curses, drain the vigor of the enemy and open a purple portal to bring a lost comrade back. Third promotion for Warlock, Reave and Faust units.

classes.name: Specialist
classes.desc: Specialists tend more to production than combat. They engage in hunting, but more often than not, this is simply for the purpose of acquiring raw materials for creating or upgrading items. Following the first promotion, Specialists may proceed to become Craftsmen, vastly improving their production capabilities.

classes.name: Craftsman
classes.desc: Craftsmen possess the capability to mine, process, produce, and create quality items. They are not considered combatants per se, but are recognized as vital to the Holy Cora Alliance.

classes.name: Artist
classes.desc: Tasked with overseeing armour supply for Alliance forces, Artisans are known for imbuing their work with both functionality and artistry.

classes.name: Runesmith
classes.desc: Runesmiths are the Holy Chaos Coalition's rune-forgers: artisans who carve living runes into flesh and steel. They mend allies with rings of light, weave a lattice of wards that resists dispelling, purge afflictions, anchor the spirit of their animus and raise a runic gate to bring the squad home. Third promotion for Artisan units.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.desc: Warrior units are built for strength and melee combat, over other classes. They utilize two-handed weapons or one-handed weapons with shields. First promotion enables Warriors to become Punisher units, which utilize two-hand weapons and skills including Mangle to deal serious damage; or Gladius units, which maximize defense capability.

classes.name: Destroyer
classes.desc: Destroyer units function as the main force for the Accretian army. They are very competent in melee combat and are the most powerful warriors among the three races on Novus.

classes.name: Gladius
classes.desc: Gladius units utilize one-hand weapons with the unique Accretian shields, which are significantly more powerful than those of other races. Gladius class skills therefore prioritize shield techniques.

classes.name: Punisher
classes.desc: Punisher units have the capacity to identify opponents weak points and use skills to ensnare enemies.

classes.name: Assaulter
classes.desc: Assaulter units equalize potent offensive and defensive capacity.

classes.name: Mercenary
classes.desc: Built to withstand Force assaults, Warders are structured with innovative frames that enable more efficient use of chargers.

classes.name: Breacher
classes.desc: Breachers are the Accretian army's siege rams, heavy assault frames built to open a line through fortified positions. They shatter enemy plating, link the attack systems of nearby allies and keep fighting by venting overheated coolant. Third promotion for Punisher, Dreadnought and Warder units.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.desc: Ranger units are built for ranged combat, utilizing bows or guns. They are supplied with increased velocity to minimize damage taken. First promotion enables Rangers to become Gunner units, which utilize Launcher attack skills; or Scout units, which utilize skills such as Trapping.

classes.name: Gunner
classes.desc: Gunner units are capable of both ranged and melee combat. All Accretian soldiers are able to utilize Launchers; however, Gunners are specifically structured for Launcher use.

classes.name: Scouter
classes.desc: Scout units are built to perform in ranged combat as well as arm and disarm traps. Scout class skills therefore prioritize trapping techniques.

classes.name: Striker
classes.desc: Annihilator units are the best designed for Launcher utilization. They are a nearly invincible force in combat.

classes.name: Dementer
classes.desc: Desolator units are built with the capacity to extricate associates from hazardous circumstances. They are able to override self-preservation mandates.

classes.name: Phantom Shadow
classes.desc: Strong offense and increased velocity enable Infiltrator units to dispense critical damage. They are often deployed to infiltrate enemy headquarters.

classes.name: Bombardier
classes.desc: Bombardiers are Accretia's heavy artillery: they paint targets for the battery, rain fire on whole positions and keep the launcher cycling faster while nano-repair units hold them together. Third promotion for Striker, Dementer and Phantom Shadow units.

classes.name: Railgunner
classes.desc: Railgunners are Accretia's precision marksmen, frames built around a single railgun rifle. They lock into a firing stance, extend their scopes and deliver armor-piercing slugs from beyond enemy reach. Third promotion for Striker, Dementer and Phantom Shadow units.

classes.name: Demolisher
classes.desc: Demolishers control the ground: they pin targets with magnetic nets, scatter fragmentation bursts, cloak in thermal haze and carry more traps than any other Ranger. Third promotion for Striker, Dementer and Phantom Shadow units.

classes.name: Specialist
classes.desc: Specialist units are built for production rather than combat. They are enabled to hunt monsters, but primarily for the purpose of obtaining raw materials to be utilized in item making and upgrading. First promotion enables Specialists to become Engineer units, which are enabled for improved production capacity.

classes.name: Engineer
classes.desc: Engineer units are built for improved production and sufficient combat ability to achieve goals and enable self-preservation.

classes.name: Scientist
classes.desc: Scientist units are built with the capacity to repair wounded soldiers and engage in defensive combat.

classes.name: Battle Leader
classes.desc: Battle Leader units are built with the capacity to increase associates speed and decrease opponents defense.

classes.name: Grenadier
classes.desc: Grenadiers turn the grenade launcher into a full battlefield system: fragmentation salvos that clear a position, smoke that blinds whole squads, concussion rounds that stun and saturation fire that buries a zone. Third promotion for Scientist and Battle Leader units.

classes.name: Field Marshal
classes.desc: Field Marshals command the Accretian line from the front: their aura sharpens every unit nearby, emergency repair crews restore the squad, shield walls harden the formation and jam signals cripple the enemy. Third promotion for Scientist and Battle Leader units.

40008.name: Bash Explosion
40008.desc: hit the target with strong shock wave

41102.name: Rail Shot
41102.desc: Charges the rail and fires a single armor-piercing slug, dealing 380% of weapon damage. Reaches 100 farther than a normal shot. Requires a firearm.

41105.name: Capacitor Burst
41105.desc: Dumps the whole capacitor bank into one overcharged shot, dealing 450% of weapon damage to a single target. Requires a firearm.

41107.name: Frag Burst
41107.desc: Detonates a fragmentation charge on the target, dealing 156% of weapon damage to every enemy in a small radius. Requires a ranged weapon.

41200.name: Saturation Fire
41200.desc: Saturates the target zone with a barrage of grenades, dealing 300% of weapon damage in a wide radius. Consumes 3 grenades. Requires a grenade launcher.

70008.name: Bash Explosion
70008.desc: hit the target with strong shock wave

70021.name: Judgment
70021.desc: A powerful blow to the ground under the user that stuns nearby enemies by causing them to lose their balance.

71129.name: Holy Lance
71129.desc: Conjures a lance of white-gold light that spirals to the target in rings and bursts in a cross of flare, dealing 2441% of weapon damage. Requires a staff.

80008.name: Bash Explosion
80008.desc: hit the target with strong shock wave

80048.name: Full Swing
80048.desc: A devastating spinning attack with the user's entire physical mass behind the swing.

80054.name: Dread Sweep
80054.desc: Whirls a crescent of shadow around the target, dealing 244% of weapon damage to every enemy in a medium radius. Requires a melee weapon.

80058.name: Executioner's Rite
80058.desc: Drops a guillotine of shadow on a single target, dealing 300% of weapon damage. Requires a melee weapon.

81146.name: Striking Force
81146.desc: Concentrate Force into a non elemental force attack

81154.name: Elemental Convergence
81154.desc: Four beams of fire, ice, earth and wind converge over the target and burst in a prismatic rose, dealing 3968% of weapon damage in a wide area (radius 84). Requires a staff.

81158.name: Plague of Ashes
81158.desc: A black plague of ashes bursts over the target and the enemies around it (radius 56), dealing 1953% of weapon damage. Requires a staff.

7F018.name: Howl
7F018.desc: A piercing war cry that temporarily increases the user's melee attack power.

7F01B.name: Defend
7F01B.desc: Improves defense ability. Shield must be equipped to use this skill.

7F01C.name: Provoke
7F01C.desc: Enrages the target by throwing a stream of insults, making it attack the user.

7001E.name: Double Crash
7001E.desc: A controlled spinning attack that can be used in quick succession.

7F01F.name: Magnetic Net
7F01F.desc: A magnetized net that prevents the target from moving.

7F020.name: Beast Eye
7F020.desc: Avoids enemy's attack with eyes of a wild beast and attack back with great power.

7F002.name: Acceleration
7F002.desc: Increase movement speed for a while

7F022.name: Stamina Zero
7F022.desc: A strike to the target's solar plexus, temporarily limiting its SP and SP recovery while they catch their breath.

7F023.name: Perfect
7F023.desc: Attacks do not miss the opponents, with the perfect handling skills of weapons.

7F024.name: Buildup Defense
7F024.desc: Increase defense power and shield defense, and EXP gaining amount.

7F025.name: Draining
7F025.desc: Absorbs the life force of enemies around the user and adds it to her own.

7F026.name: Taunt
7F026.desc: Makes monster around you to attack.(Increase aggressiveness of monster by wide range)

7F02A.name: Rallying Verdict
7F02A.desc: Proclaims a verdict over you and an allied unit, raising melee attack and melee skill attack by 15% and critical hit rate by 10 for 1080 seconds.

7002B.name: Sanctified Smite
7002B.desc: Brings the blade down wrapped in holy light, dealing 270% of weapon damage to a single target. Requires a melee weapon.

7F02C.name: Purging Light
7F02C.desc: Bathes you or an allied unit in cleansing light, instantly restoring 25% of maximum HP.

7F02D.name: Bulwark Oath
7F02D.desc: Swears a bulwark oath over you and an allied unit, raising Final Defense by 20% and evasion by 20 for 1080 seconds.

7F02E.name: Second Wind
7F02E.desc: Draws a deep breath and steels the body, instantly restoring 30% of your maximum HP. Only works while HP is at 80% or lower.

7F096.name: Stretch
7F096.desc: increase long range attack rate and accuracy rate

F9003.name: Hold
F9003.desc: Immobilizes the target, preventing movement for a short time.

7F099.name: Hide
7F099.desc: Temporarily hide oneself from enemy. Accuracy rate is increased.[Monster attack instinct decreases little]

7F09A.name: TRAPPING
7F09A.desc: Set up a booby trap that detonates when an enemy walks over it.

7F09B.name: FIND TRAP
7F09B.desc: Find hidden traps by observating anomalies on the terrain.

700A8.name: Throwing Knife Strike
700A8.desc: A quick strike with a throwing knife, dealing direct damage.

7F0A9.name: Entangling Throw
7F0A9.desc: Throws a tangling cord along with the knife, immobilizing the target for a short time.

7F0AA.name: Throwing Knife Mastery
7F0AA.desc: Increases damage dealt while a throwing knife is equipped.

7F09D.name: Quick Attack
7F09D.desc: Quickens reaction time, temporarily decreasing the skill delay of all ranged skills.

7100C.name: Long distance firing
7100C.desc: Increase accuracy rate, make the target stern.

7F09F.name: Divine
7F09F.desc: Purified by Light Force all forms of skill and force are removed from him.

7F0A0.name: Mental Assault
7F0A0.desc: A precise strike at mental fortitude, temporarily decreasing  the target's maximum FP.

7F0A1.name: Scamper
7F0A1.desc: Decreases Dodge and Attack Speed but increases Movement Speed [Increases monster's aggresivity a little]

700A2.name: Fatal Stab
700A2.desc: A powerful stab at the target's vitals; must be done from hiding.

7F0A3.name: Trap Box
7F0A3.desc: A utility belt that allows the user to carry more traps.

7F0B5.name: Spotter's Call
7F0B5.desc: Calls out targets and wind over you and an allied unit, raising ranged attack and ranged skill attack by 12%, accuracy by 20 and critical hit rate by 10 for 1080 seconds.

7F0B6.name: Trail Blaze
7F0B6.desc: Breaks into a run along a hidden trail, raising movement speed by 2.0 and avoid by 20 for 10 seconds.

710B7.name: Piercing Gaze
710B7.desc: Takes a long, steady sight on a distant mark and fires one shot for 244% of weapon damage. Reaches 120 farther than a normal shot. Requires a bow or firearm.

7F0B8.name: Wayfinder's Respite
7F0B8.desc: Tends the wounds of you or an allied unit in the field, instantly restoring 20% of maximum HP.

710B9.name: Skewer Volley
710B9.desc: Looses a fan of skewering shots that lands on the target and every enemy within a medium radius, dealing 300% of weapon damage to each. Consumes 2 rounds. Requires a bow or firearm.

7F0AB.name: Heavy Stance
7F0AB.desc: Plants the feet and braces the heavy gun, raising ranged attack and ranged skill attack by 40%, at the cost of 15 avoid and 1.5 seconds of extra recovery on every skill, for 1080 seconds.

710AC.name: Buckshot Blast
710AC.desc: Fires a burst of buckshot that tears through the target and every enemy in a wide arc around it, dealing 380% of weapon damage to each. Consumes 4 rounds. Requires a firearm.

7F0AD.name: Marked Prey
7F0AD.desc: Marks a target as prey, lowering its Final Defense by 20% and its avoid by 20 for 30 seconds.

710AE.name: Point-Blank Finisher
710AE.desc: Empties both barrels into a single target for 480% of weapon damage. Consumes 2 rounds. Requires a firearm.

7F0AF.name: Brace
7F0AF.desc: Unfolds hexagonal plating around the body, raising Final Defense by 30% and Armor Defense by 15% for 20 seconds.

7F0B0.name: Net Toss
7F0B0.desc: Hurls a weighted net that closes around the target, blocking its movement for 5 seconds and lowering its avoid by 15. Requires a bow or firearm.

710B1.name: Powder Flash
710B1.desc: Detonates a magnesium flare on the target, dealing 156% of weapon damage to every enemy in a small radius. Consumes 1 round. Requires a bow or firearm.

7F0B2.name: Ghost Step
7F0B2.desc: Dissolves into blue-gold sand, turning stealthy and raising movement speed by 1.0 for 20 seconds. Attacking breaks the stealth.

7F0B3.name: Sapper's Eye
7F0B3.desc: A mechanical monocle sweeps the ground and reveals hidden traps (Trap Detection) and raises avoid by 20 for 1080 seconds.

710B4.name: Kill Zone
710B4.desc: Marks a hexagonal detonation grid on the ground that erupts under the target, dealing 240% of weapon damage to every enemy within a medium radius. Consumes 2 rounds. Requires a bow or firearm.

7F114.name: Edian's Soul
7F114.desc: By emulating Edian's teachings, the caster improves her force attack power.

7F117.name: Recall
7F117.desc: Instantly transmits a willing party member to your current location.

7F118.name: Heal Wind
7F118.desc: Guides the Light Force into a gentle breeze that heals all party members around the caster.

7F11D.name: Force Freezing
7F11D.desc: Temporarily slip outside the flow of time; the caster is invincible, but cannot attack either.

7F11E.name: Return Gate
7F11E.desc: Opens a temporal warp gate that can return the caster's party members to her binding location.

7F11F.name: Escape
7F11F.desc: A last-ditch escape that returns the caster back in time to her binding location.

7F126.name: Halo of Wrath
7F126.desc: A golden halo crowns you or an allied unit and blades of light orbit the weapon, raising Force attack, melee attack and melee skill attack by 12% for 1080 seconds.

7F127.name: Aegis of Dawn
7F127.desc: A solar disc rises behind you or an allied unit, raising Final Defense by 25% and evasion by 20 for 20 seconds.

7F128.name: Dawnfall Mend
7F128.desc: A sweep of dawn light restores 15% of the maximum HP of you or an allied unit at once (only while HP is at 80% or lower) and quickens HP recovery by 60% for 30 seconds.

7112A.name: Solar Verdict
7112A.desc: A small sun descends over the target and detonates in a golden corona, dealing 2441% of weapon damage to every enemy in a wide area (radius 70). Requires a staff.

7F12B.name: Time Dilation
7F12B.desc: Clock-face rings turn around your hips: your class skills cool down 3 seconds faster and your Force casts 2 seconds faster for 1080 seconds.

7112C.name: Temporal Collapse
7112C.desc: A sphere of compressed time implodes over the target, dragging the enemies around it inward before bursting in a copper-blue wave, dealing 2441% of weapon damage (radius 70). Requires a staff.

7F12D.name: Fracture Timeline
7F12D.desc: Cracks the timeline of the target like shattered glass: its skills and Force casts take 3 seconds longer and its evasion drops by 20 for 60 seconds. Requires a staff.

7F12E.name: Temporal Echo
7F12E.desc: Leaves a translucent sepia afterimage of yourself that fights beside you (40% of your damage, 30% of your HP, 60 s) and soaks part of monster hits. Recast replaces the echo.

7F12F.name: Time Snare
7F12F.desc: A giant hourglass sprouts over the target and golden sand binds its feet, rooting it for 6 seconds. Requires a staff.

7F192.name: Set Guard Tower
7F192.desc: Allows the Mechanic to set up machine gun turrets that fire on enemies.

7F198.name: Gauge Recovery
7F198.desc: Performs repairs on target's armor, restoring his defense gauge.

7F199.name: Rebirth
7F199.desc: Performs advanced medical treatment on a fallen ally, reviving her to full health.

7F19B.name: Armored Mastery
7F19B.desc: Long experience and training with MAUs enables the Rider to use a MAU to its full potential, improving attack and defense power while riding a MAU.

7F19C.name: Repair Discount
7F19C.desc: Official endorsement from the Bellato High Command allows the Rider to obtain a discount for MAU repairs.

7F1A4.name: Reinforced Frame
7F1A4.desc: Wraps you or an allied unit in a holographic reinforced frame, raising Final Defense by 25% and avoid by 10 for 1080 seconds.

7F1A5.name: Repair Wave
7F1A5.desc: Releases a wave of repair nanites that instantly restores 15% of maximum HP to you or an allied unit. Only works while the target's HP is at 80% or lower.

7F1A6.name: Gauge Surge
7F1A6.desc: Surges power through your own gauge, instantly restoring 50% of your maximum DP.

7F1A7.name: Overwatch Grid
7F1A7.desc: Projects a blue grid of speed lines under you or an allied unit, raising movement speed by 1.5 for 1080 seconds.

7F1A8.name: Static Snare
7F1A8.desc: A Tesla coil lashes an electric arc around the target, blocking its movement for 4 seconds and lowering its Final Defense by 10%.

7F1A9.name: Overdrive Core
7F1A9.desc: Overclocks the reactor of your armor unit, raising Unit Attack by 30% for 1080 seconds. Class skills cannot be used while riding: cast it on foot before mounting.

7F1AA.name: Hull Plating
7F1AA.desc: Welds extra plating on the frame, raising Final Defense by 25% on foot and avoid by 20 both on foot and inside the unit, for 1080 seconds. Cast it before mounting.

7F1AB.name: Field Weld
7F1AB.desc: A welding torch runs a blue arc over the frame, instantly restoring 30% of your maximum HP. Only works while HP is at 80% or lower.

7F1AC.name: Ejector Boost
7F1AC.desc: Fires the ejector boosters, raising movement speed by 1.5 and accuracy by 25 for 20 seconds. Accuracy also counts for the unit's guns once mounted.

7F1AD.name: Target Lock
7F1AD.desc: Closes square lock brackets on a target, lowering its Final Defense by 15% and its avoid by 25 for 30 seconds, so the unit's guns hit it easily.

8F042.name: Vision
8F042.desc: Allows the user to see an opponent's hidden weak points, temporarily increasing the chance to cause critical attacks.

8F043.name: Faith
8F043.desc: Faith in DECEM is rewarded with heightened physical ability.  Temporarily increases attack and defense power.

8F045.name: Trust
8F045.desc: Trust in the will of DECEM is rewarded with increased fortitude.  Temporarily increases defense power and HP and FP recovery rate.

8F046.name: Life Leach
8F046.desc: Absorbs the life force of enemies around the user and adds it to her own.

8F047.name: Disability Forcing
8F047.desc: Hypnotize monsters to attack.(Increase aggressiveness of monster by moderate)

8F049.name: Sprint
8F049.desc: By breaking into a full run, the user maximizes his movement rate.

8F04A.name: Grace
8F04A.desc: With physical ability blessed by the Oracle, it increases attack power and accuracy.

8F002.name: Acceleration
8F002.desc: Increase movement speed for a while

8F04B.name: Quick Charge
8F04B.desc: By energizing his body metabolism, the user is able to recover from using skills more rapidly.  Temporarily decreases delay of all melee skills.

8F04C.name: Muscle Break
8F04C.desc: Strikes pressure points on an opponent's arm, temporarily decreasing the target's attack power.

8F04E.name: Hypnotic Power
8F04E.desc: Increase defense power and shield defense, and EXP gaining amount.

8F055.name: Soul Chain
8F055.desc: Spectral iron chains burst from the ground and bind the target, blocking its movement for 6 seconds.

8F056.name: Blood Pact
8F056.desc: Seals a pact in blood: 10% of all damage you deal returns to you as HP and melee attack rises by 10% for 1080 seconds.

8F057.name: Grave Ward
8F057.desc: Raises spectral sarcophagus plates around you, raising Final Defense by 35% and Armor Defense by 15% for 30 seconds.

8F0C0.name: Hold
8F0C0.desc: Summons mystic trap jaws to render the target immobile.

810C1.name: Inspired Shot
810C1.desc: A divine vision from DECEM shows the user the perfect target to aim for.

8F0C3.name: Silent Step
8F0C3.desc: By muting all sound and hiding in the surroundings, the user temporarily becomes invisible to enemies.

8F0C4.name: TRAPPING
8F0C4.desc: Sets up a hidden trap that goes off when an enemy walks over it.

8F0C5.name: FIND TRAP
8F0C5.desc: Find hidden traps by noticing unnatural features on the land.

8F0C6.name: Precise Striking
8F0C6.desc: Improves ranged attack Hit and Damage

8F0C7.name: Correct Eye
8F0C7.desc: Increase the range of bows and guns

8100C.name: Long distance firing
8100C.desc: Increase accuracy rate, make the target stern.

8F0C9.name: Feign Death
8F0C9.desc: Temporarily stops the user's vital signs and give the appearance of death.

8F0CA.name: Hit Confusion
8F0CA.desc: Creates hallucinations that sap mental strength and greatly decreases the target's maximum FP.

8F0CB.name: Blink Illusion
8F0CB.desc: By moving in graceful hypnotic patterns, her dodge is increased by a significant amount for short period of time.

800CC.name: Extinction
800CC.desc: A powerful attack that slashes the target's throat; must be done from Silent Step

8F0CD.name: Trap Box
8F0CD.desc: A shoulder harness that allows the user to carry more traps.

8F0D2.name: Steady Aim
8F0D2.desc: Steadies breath and scope, raising ranged attack and ranged skill attack by 30%, firearm range by 100 and critical hit rate by 25 for 1080 seconds.

8F0D3.name: Dusk Mark
8F0D3.desc: Brands a target with a crescent-moon mark, lowering its Final Defense by 20% and its avoid by 20 for 30 seconds.

810D4.name: Long Shot
810D4.desc: Squeezes off a shot from beyond the horizon, dealing 340% of weapon damage to a single target. Reaches 150 farther than a normal shot. Requires a firearm.

810D5.name: Headshot
810D5.desc: Takes the shot that ends the fight, dealing 460% of weapon damage to a single target. Reaches 100 farther than a normal shot. Requires a firearm.

8F0D6.name: Shadow Reposition
8F0D6.desc: Dissolves into a flock of crows, turning stealthy and raising movement speed by 1.5 for 10 seconds. Attacking breaks the stealth.

8F0D7.name: Wind Stance
8F0D7.desc: Settles into the rhythm of the wind, raising ranged attack and ranged skill attack by 20%, bow range by 80 and critical hit rate by 20 for 1080 seconds.

810D8.name: Piercing Arrow
810D8.desc: Looses a spiraling arrow that drills through defenses, dealing 320% of weapon damage to a single target. Reaches 80 farther than a normal shot. Requires a bow.

8F0D9.name: Gale Step
8F0D9.desc: Bursts forward in a rush of wind and leaves, raising movement speed by 2.5 and avoid by 20 for 6 seconds.

8F0DA.name: Hawk's Eye
8F0DA.desc: Borrows the sight of a hawk, raising accuracy by 40, critical hit rate by 30 and critical damage by 25% for 1080 seconds.

810DB.name: Storm Volley
810DB.desc: Sends a tornado of arrows spiraling onto the target, dealing 240% of weapon damage to every enemy within a medium radius. Consumes 3 arrows. Requires a bow.

8F0DC.name: Spirit Net
8F0DC.desc: Drops a lasso of green-violet soul-thread on the target, blocking its movement for 4 seconds and lowering its Final Defense by 10%. Requires a bow or firearm.

810DD.name: Withering Cloud
810DD.desc: Bursts a toxic green-violet fog on the target that withers the ground, dealing 156% of weapon damage to every enemy in a small radius. Consumes 1 arrow or round. Requires a bow or firearm.

8F0DE.name: Vanish Step
8F0DE.desc: Black ink smoke swallows the body, turning it stealthy and raising movement speed by 1.0 for 20 seconds. Attacking breaks the stealth.

8F0DF.name: Omen
8F0DF.desc: An omen eye opens on the ground and shows every hidden trap (Trap Detection), raising critical hit rate by 15 and avoid by 15 for 1080 seconds.

810E0.name: Poison Field
810E0.desc: Seeds a wide field of bursting spores under the target, dealing 200% of weapon damage to every enemy within a large radius. Consumes 2 arrows or rounds. Requires a bow or firearm.

8F13E.name: Channel
8F13E.desc: Draws directly upon the Dark Force to improve force attack power.

8F145.name: Stone Curse
8F145.desc: Curses the target to temporarily turn into immovable, immortal stone.  Target cannot move but cannot be damaged either.

8F147.name: Force Shield
8F147.desc: Uses the Dark Force to create a barrier that prevents damage.  Every point of damage the barrier receives drains 2 FP.

8F148.name: Return Gate
8F148.desc: Opens a portal that returns the caster's  party members to his binding location.

8F149.name: Escape
8F149.desc: A last-ditch escape option that calls on the Dark Force to return the caster to his binding location.

8F14A.name: Animus Rest
8F14A.desc: Send Dark Force into the Animus world, revitalizing one of the caster's Animus.

8F14B.name: Fast Recall
8F14B.desc: Channel the Dark Force into a rift between worlds, cancelling the wait time between summoning Animus.

8F14C.name: Anima Maxima
8F14C.desc: By infusing an Animus with Dark Force, the caster can increase the Animus' powers.

8F14D.name: Life Conflict
8F14D.desc: Increase Maximum HP of target by 10%, and increase attack power by 5%.

8F150.name: Pyre Twin
8F150.desc: Calls a twin of living ember (70% of your damage, 15% of your HP, 180 s) that lashes your target in fast bursts. It shields you by absorbing part of monster hits. While it burns your Force Attack is raised by 8%. Recast replaces the twin.

8F151.name: Glacial Twin
8F151.desc: Calls a twin of crystal ice (45% of your damage, 50% of your HP, 180 s), the durable controller of the set. Debuffs you cast last 25% longer while it stands. Recast replaces the twin.

8F152.name: Stone Twin
8F152.desc: Calls a twin of mossy stone (30% of your damage, 90% of your HP, 180 s), the bulwark of the set: it soaks three times more monster damage than the others. Your Final Defense is raised by 10% while it stands. Recast replaces the twin.

8F153.name: Tempest Twin
8F153.desc: Calls a twin of storm cloud (25% of your damage per strike, 20% of your HP, 180 s) that strikes at triple speed. Your movement speed is raised by 1.0 while it rages. Recast replaces the twin.

8F155.name: Prism Sunder
8F155.desc: A prism shatters over the target into four colored shards, lowering its fire, water, earth and wind tolerance by 60 for 60 seconds. Requires a staff.

8F156.name: Archmage's Mantle
8F156.desc: A mantle of four elemental ribbons wraps you, raising Force Attack by 20% and reducing Force FP cost by 15% for 1080 seconds.

8F157.name: Hex of Frailty
8F157.desc: A violet bone-rune sigil cracks the target, lowering its melee, ranged, melee skill, ranged skill and Force attack by 20% for 90 seconds. Requires a staff.

8F159.name: Soul Drain
8F159.desc: Blue-green soul filaments feed you: for 60 seconds 30% of the damage you deal returns as FP and 10% as HP.

8F15A.name: Dread Legion
8F15A.desc: Violet flame and ghost hands fuse you with your animus: Animus Attack +60%, Animus Defense +40%, Animus Heal +30%, your Final Defense +15% and damage-to-HP +8% for 1080 seconds.

8F15B.name: Wraith Legion
8F15B.desc: Rips three ragged wraiths from shadow portals (40% of your damage each, 25% of your HP each, 45 s). They strike your target and soak part of monster hits. Recast replaces the legion.

8F15C.name: Phantom Grasp
8F15C.desc: Purple spectral hands claw out of the ground and hold the target's legs for 4 seconds while its Final Defense drops by 15%. Requires a staff.

8115D.name: Netherbolt
8115D.desc: Hurls a lance of black-violet void that swallows the light and bursts into a skull at the target, dealing 3052% of weapon damage. Requires a staff.

8F15E.name: Dark Mend
8F15E.desc: Rose-violet mist rises around you or an allied unit, instantly restoring 22% of maximum HP. Only works while the target's HP is at 80% or lower.

8F15F.name: Shadow Ward
8F15F.desc: A thin silhouette of shadow clings to you or an allied unit like a second skin, raising avoid by 25 and Final Defense by 15% for 1080 seconds.

8F160.name: Curse Purge
8F160.desc: A white spiral erases dark runes from you or an allied unit, removing every harmful Force effect (curses).

8F161.name: Vigor Siphon
8F161.desc: Crimson streams drain the vigor of the target, lowering its HP, FP and SP recovery by 50% for 30 seconds. Requires a staff.

8F162.name: Dusk Recall
8F162.desc: Opens a vertical purple portal and pulls an allied party member to your side.

8F1BC.name: Set Guard Tower
8F1BC.desc: Allows the Craftsman to set up arrow towers that shoot at enemies.

8F1C2.name: Gauge Recovery
8F1C2.desc: Mends the target's armor, restoring her defense gauge.

8F1C3.name: Rebirth
8F1C3.desc: Revives the spirit of a fallen ally, returning her to full health.

8F1CE.name: Mender's Touch
8F1CE.desc: Three rune rings rise around you or an allied unit, instantly restoring 18% of maximum HP. Only works while the target's HP is at 80% or lower.

8F1CF.name: Ward Lattice
8F1CF.desc: Weaves a translucent lattice of runes over you or an allied unit, raising Final Defense by 15% and resistance to having your buffs dispelled by 30 for 1080 seconds.

8F1D0.name: Purge Field
8F1D0.desc: A white fog with dissolving runes washes over you or an allied unit and removes the most recent harmful effect.

8F1D1.name: Spirit Anchor
8F1D1.desc: Drops an anchor of light beneath your animus, raising Animus Attack by 25% and Animus Defense by 25% for 1080 seconds.

8F1D2.name: Rally Gate
8F1D2.desc: Raises a runic stone arch with violet flame that sets a return position for your party. Party members can use it to come back to the spot.

4006C.name: Mangle
4006C.desc: An aggressive four-hit attack aimed at crippling the target.

4F06D.name: Shield Battery
4F06D.desc: Creates a recovery matrix around the user, temporarily increasing  HP and FP recovery rate.

4F06F.name: Mega Shield
4F06F.desc: Charges energy through the user's shield, increasing defense power and block rate.

4F070.name: Might
4F070.desc: Increases the heat pressure in the user's dynamic servimotors, temporarily increasing melee attack speed.

4F071.name: Irritate
4F071.desc: Causes target's fury and attack(Increase aggressiveness of monster by moderate)

4F072.name: Rage Blow
4F072.desc: A ragged cut that leaves a gaping wound, causing the target to gradually lose HP.

4F073.name: Magnetic Net
4F073.desc: A magnetized net that prevents the target from moving.

4F074.name: Magnetic Arm
4F074.desc: Increases the eleectromagnetic energy around the user's arm, temporarily increasing melee attack power and accuracy.

4F002.name: Acceleration
4F002.desc: Increase movement speed for a while

4F075.name: Capacity Engine
4F075.desc: Raises the efficiency of the user's core to structural tolerance limits, temporarily increasing attack power.

4F076.name: Limit Gauge
4F076.desc: Increases the structural tolerance of the user's frame, temporarily increasing defense gauge.

4F078.name: Elemental Barrier
4F078.desc: Creates an energy barrier that greatly increases all elemental resistances.

4F079.name: Excel Charger
4F079.desc: Increase effect of HP charger and exp gaining amount.

4F07A.name: Cry
4F07A.desc: Gets monster's attention with a cry.(Increase aggressiveness of monster by wide range)

4007E.name: Ram Assault
4007E.desc: Drives the frame's full weight into the target in a heavy ramming charge, dealing 244% of weapon damage. Reaches 120 farther than a normal attack.

4F07F.name: Armor Breach
4F07F.desc: A concentrated strike that cracks the target's plating, lowering its Final Defense by 35% and its Defense by 20% for 90 seconds.

4F080.name: Link Overdrive
4F080.desc: Opens a combat link between you and an allied unit, raising melee attack and melee skill attack by 15% and movement speed by 1.0 for 1080 seconds.

4F081.name: Coolant Flush
4F081.desc: Vents the overheated coolant and reroutes power, instantly restoring 30% of your maximum HP.

4F082.name: Overclock Shell
4F082.desc: Overclocks the plating shell for a short window, raising Final Defense by 30% and Shield Block by 10 for 30 seconds.

4F0EA.name: Flash-Bang
4F0EA.desc: Cause a blinding flash and loud explosion that disorients the target and temporarily reduces his dodge ability.

410EB.name: Heavy Shot
410EB.desc: The user sets his mass and fires a powerful launcher shot.

410EC.name: Compound Siege
410EC.desc: Using the siege kit as a catapult platform, the user fires an explosive launcher shot at target and enemies nearby.

4F0ED.name: Cloaking
4F0ED.desc: Activates stealth plating and temporarily becomes invisible to enemies.

4F0EE.name: TRAPPING
4F0EE.desc: Sets proximity mines that explode when an enemy walks over it.

4F0EF.name: FIND TRAP
4F0EF.desc: Find hidden traps by detecting non-organic chemical compounds.

410ED.name: Final Blast
410ED.desc: A devastating launcher attack using energy reserves.

410EF.name: Chain Rocket
410EF.desc: Using the siege kit as a stable platform, the user rapidly fires three sets of launcher attacks at one target.

4F0F1.name: Siege Mastery
4F0F1.desc: By operating the siege kit to the limits of structural tolerance instead of safety limits, the user temporarily increases attack and defense power while in siege mode.

4F0F3.name: Detonate
4F0F3.desc: By overloading his energy core, the user can self-destruct and deal massive damage to surrounding enemies.

4F0FA.name: Hyper R.P.M
4F0FA.desc: Increase long distance attack power with maximizing engine output

4F0F5.name: Gate Capsule
4F0F5.desc: Sets up a teleport beacon that returns the user's party members to his binding location.

4100C.name: Long distance firing
4100C.desc: Increase accuracy rate, make the target stern.

400F6.name: Illusion Attack
400F6.desc: A powerful attack that bypasses the target's defenses; must be done while Cloaked.

4F0F7.name: Trap Box
4F0F7.desc: Extra compartments designed to carry more traps.

4F0FC.name: Target Painter
4F0FC.desc: Marks the target for the battery, lowering its Final Defense by 20% and its avoid by 20 for 90 seconds.

410FD.name: Carpet Barrage
410FD.desc: Calls down a carpet of rockets on the target zone, dealing 305% of weapon damage to every enemy in the blast radius. Requires a launcher.

4F0FE.name: Recoil Dampers
4F0FE.desc: Engages the recoil dampers, raising Final Defense by 25%, launcher attack by 10% and movement speed by 1.0 for 1080 seconds.

4F0FF.name: Overwatch Protocol
4F0FF.desc: Switches the launcher to overwatch mode, cutting its attack delay by 1000 ms for 15 seconds.

4F100.name: Nano Repair
4F100.desc: Releases a cloud of repair nanites that instantly restores 30% of your maximum HP.

4F101.name: Rail Stance
4F101.desc: Locks the frame into a firing stance, raising ranged attack and ranged skill attack by 25% and accuracy by 30, at the cost of 20 avoid, for 1080 seconds.

4F103.name: Thermal Scope
4F103.desc: Deploys a thermal scope, extending firearm attack range by 100 and raising critical hit rate by 20 for 1080 seconds.

4F104.name: Thruster Dash
4F104.desc: Fires the back thrusters, raising movement speed by 2.5 and avoid by 10 for 6 seconds.

4F106.name: Mag Net
4F106.desc: Fires a magnetic net that pins the target in place, blocking its movement for 5 seconds.

4F108.name: Thermal Cloak
4F108.desc: Bends heat and light around the frame, turning you invisible and raising movement speed by 1.0 for 20 seconds. Attacking breaks the cloak.

4F109.name: Sensor Grid
4F109.desc: Spreads a sensor grid that reveals enemy traps and raises ranged accuracy by 20 for 1080 seconds.

4F1E6.name: Install Guard Tower
4F1E6.desc: Allows the Engineer to set up a missile tower that fires on enemies.

4F1EC.name: Instant Repair
4F1EC.desc: Restores power and reroutes subroutines to a fallen ally, restoring him to full operational status.

4F1ED.name: Gauge Recovery
4F1ED.desc: Uses nanites to repair the target's frame, recovering his defense gauge.

4F1EF.name: Nimble Joint
4F1EF.desc: Increases the target's movement speed by maximizing his hydraulic thrusters.

4F1F0.name: Barrier
4F1F0.desc: Sets up an impenetrable barrier around the Leader.  He is temporarily invincible, but cannot move or attack.

4F1F1.name: Gauge Down
4F1F1.desc: Use nanites to break down target's armor, reducing his defense gauge.

411FD.name: Fragmentation Salvo
411FD.desc: Fires a pair of fragmentation rounds that burst on the target, dealing 300% of weapon damage to every enemy within the blast radius. Consumes 2 grenades. Requires a grenade launcher.

4F1FE.name: Smoke Screen
4F1FE.desc: Lobs a smoke canister that blinds every enemy in a wide radius around the target, lowering their accuracy by 30 for 8 seconds.

411FF.name: Shock Round
411FF.desc: Detonates a concussion round on the target, dealing 200% of weapon damage in a small radius and stunning the target. Requires a grenade launcher.

4F201.name: Ballistic Sight
4F201.desc: Calibrates the launcher's ballistic computer, extending attack range by 80 and raising critical hit rate by 15 for 1080 seconds.

4F202.name: Command Aura
4F202.desc: Projects a command aura over you or an ally, raising melee, ranged, melee skill and ranged skill attack by 12% for 1080 seconds.

4F203.name: Emergency Repair
4F203.desc: Dispatches repair drones to every party member in range, instantly restoring 50% of their maximum HP.

4F204.name: Shield Wall
4F204.desc: Raises a hardened shield wall around you or an ally, increasing Final Defense by 25% for 1080 seconds.

4F205.name: Rally Point
4F205.desc: Plants a rally beacon and opens a return gate to your bind position that your party can use.

4F206.name: Jam Signal
4F206.desc: Broadcasts a jamming signal around the target, lowering the attack of every enemy in a wide radius by 20% for 30 seconds.
